observations: Photo 0 shows a white and grey overlock sewing machine with the brand 'ELEGANT' visible on a red oval label on the top head.
The machine has four white thread spools on top and a control panel with an orange label on the front right side.
It is placed on a white styrofoam base, with a pink fabric sample wrapped in plastic on the throat plate.
In the background, cardboard boxes are visible, one labeled 'MADE IN CHINA' and another with 'Emel' branding.
Photo 1 shows a side view of the same machine, with 'ELEGANT' written on a red label on the side and a model number plate reading '747-214M2-24'.
The machine has a grey body with a black motor housing on the right side.
Photo 2 shows a front view of the machine, again with 'ELEGANT' on the front and the model number '747-214M2-24' visible on a small plate below the control panel.
The machine is still on the styrofoam base, and the background includes boxes labeled 'TWO LION INDUSTRIAL SEWING MACHINE' and 'LEADING IN TECHNOLOGY'.

claims.evidence: Photos show a heavy-duty overlock machine with multiple thread spools, industrial build, and branding consistent with industrial use. The model number and 'industrial' labeling on background boxes support the claim.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video or photo of the machine running, showing needle movement, thread tension, and stitch quality.

risks.risk: Machine may be used or refurbished without disclosure
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the machine's interior, motor, and needle area showing wear, rust, or signs of prior use.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or parts (e.g., foot, bobbins, manual)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running to confirm functionality.
Close-up photos of the motor, needle, and internal components to check for wear or damage.
Photo of all included accessories and manuals.
response.reason: The machine is identifiable as an ELEGANT 747-214M2-24 industrial overlock sewing machine, and the seller's claim is supported by visual evidence. However, functionality, condition, and completeness cannot be verified from the photos alone. Without proof of working condition and included parts, the item must be priced at its worst case, which requires further evidence.
